quizzes.question: Which of these best explains why cattle worked as money in early societies?
options: Cattle were issued by a central authority
Cattle were widely recognised and trusted as valuable within the community
Cattle could be divided into infinitely small units

quizzes.question: A form of money that is easy to carry and divide into small amounts is described as having which property?
If a currency loses half its purchasing power over ten years, which property of good money has weakened?
